_about: MCQ registry. One entry per age. An age with no "sets" gets a "questions coming soon" hub. A set with "live": true needs assets/questions/<setId>-<level>.json for every level it lists; its rev is read from those files. See CLAUDE.md rule 7. A set with "access": "login" is not a file: its questions live in the Supabase table mcq_papers, so it needs "rev" here (a whole number) and no file in assets/questions/. See CLAUDE.md rule 15.
